questions.question: Which lake holds the title of the largest freshwater lake by volume in the world?
questions.fun_fact: Lake Baikal in Russia contains roughly 20% of the world's unfrozen surface freshwater.

questions.question: What is the chemical element with the symbol 'W', derived from its German name wolfram?
questions.fun_fact: Tungsten has the highest melting point of all known elements in pure form, reaching 3,422 degrees Celsius.

questions.question: The Code of Hammurabi, one of the oldest deciphered writings of significant length in the world, originated from which ancient civilization?
questions.fun_fact: Carved onto a massive basalt stele, the Code of Hammurabi famously outlined the doctrine of 'an eye for an eye'.

questions.question: Which classic 1941 film features the famous and frequently misquoted line, 'Play it, Sam. Play 'As Time Goes By''?
questions.fun_fact: In the actual film Casablanca, Ingrid Bergman's character actually says, 'Play it, Sam. Play 'As Time Goes By'.' without using the word 'again'.

questions.question: What is the primary spirit used to make a traditional French cocktail known as a French 75?
questions.fun_fact: The French 75 combines gin, champagne, lemon juice, and sugar, and was named after a powerful French 75-millimeter field gun from World War I.

questions.question: What unique physical trait distinguishes all species of adult female baleen whales from toothed whales?
options: They have two blowhole openings instead of one
They possess gills in their embryonic stage
questions.fun_fact: Baleen whales, such as the blue whale and humpback whale, are easily identified at the surface by their characteristic double blowholes.

questions.question: In what year were the first modern Olympic Games held in Athens, Greece?
questions.fun_fact: Organized by the International Olympic Committee, the 1896 Games featured athletes from just 14 nations competing across 43 events.

questions.question: What is the linguistic term for a word formed from the initial letters of a series of other words, which can be pronounced as a single word like 'NASA'?
questions.fun_fact: While all acronyms are abbreviations, not all abbreviations are acronyms because many, like FBI, are initialized rather than pronounced as words.

questions.question: Which moon of Saturn is the only moon in our solar system known to possess a dense atmosphere and stable bodies of surface liquid?
questions.fun_fact: Titan's dense atmosphere is primarily composed of nitrogen, and its surface lakes and rivers are made of liquid methane and ethane.

questions.question: Which mountain pass connects the countries of Pakistan and Afghanistan, historically serving as a crucial trade route of the Khyber Pass region?
questions.fun_fact: The Khyber Pass cuts through the Safed Koh mountains, forming an essential link in the ancient Silk Road trading networks.
